info.name: Amazon Kendra API
info.description:
The Amazon Kendra API enables programmatic management of intelligent enterprise search indexes, data source connectors, query execution, relevance tuning, and experience configuration for ML-powered search across organizational knowledge bases.

Contact Support:
 Name: AWS Support
